audit.whatIsWrong: Four errors. (1) 'her passive shreds your armor' / 'passive shred' appears three times. Ionian Fervor gives Irelia stacking ATTACK SPEED and, at max stacks, bonus on-hit damage. It shreds nothing. (2) 'she can pull marks off your passive' — Irelia's Marks come from her own Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge; K'Sante's passive has nothing to do with them. (3) 'the W block eats your W charge' / 'Don't W into her W — she blocks the burst and you waste the unstoppable'. Defiant Dance is not a block: she takes reduced PHYSICAL damage while charging, and K'Sante's Path Maker is not unstoppable — it is damage reduction. (4) 'Q3 knock-up' again; Ntofo Strikes pulls.
audit.why: The armour-shred claim tells a K'Sante player his core stat is being invalidated and pushes him off the build that wins this lane. The 'block' framing tells him a trade is impossible when in fact only the physical portion is reduced. And the real interaction the page never states is the one that matters most: Bladesurge's cooldown REFRESHES on a Marked or dying target, which is precisely why denying reset targets is the win condition the tldr already claims without explaining.

edits.before: Level 1 you only have Q and no engage, so just farm — she has no reset target to abuse you with yet either. The danger starts at 2-3: her Q dashes through minions to reach you and her E stun sets up her trade, and she can pull marks off your passive to shred you. Your one real punish is Q3's knock-up-and-pull — if she Q-dashes onto you and her reset is on a minion that's dying, W to brace the E stun and Q3 her before she can Q-reset out. edits.after: Level 1 you only have Q and no engage, so just farm — she has no reset target to abuse you with yet either. The danger starts at 2-3: her Q dashes through minions to reach you and her E stun sets up her trade, and every Mark it lands refreshes that dash. Your one real punish is Q3's shockwave pull — if she Q-dashes onto you and her reset is on a minion that's dying, W to brace the E stun and Q3 her before she can Q-reset out. Don't throw a naked Q she'll just dash around.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your lane-control peak as a tank — trade around her E and Q cooldowns and bank small leads with your bulk, because her sustained DPS can't break you while your W is up. At 6 it flips: All Out strips your tankiness, and her ult plus a stacked E stun out-damages your duelist form while her passive shreds the armor you're leaning on. Don't W into her W — she blocks the burst and you waste the unstoppable. Hold W to eat her E stun instead, and only ult if you've already baited her E down.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are genuinely even — trade around her 16s E and bank small leads with your bulk, because her sustained DPS can't break you while your W is up. At 6 it flips: All Out strips your tankiness, and her ult plus a stacked E stun out-damages your duelist form while Ionian Fervor stacks her attack speed. Don't spend W into a charging Defiant Dance — it cuts the physical damage she takes, so the trade lands short. Hold it for her E stun, and only ult once that E is baited down.

notes: Three fabrications corrected. (1) 'Her passive shreds your armor' appears three times — Ionian Fervor stacks ATTACK SPEED and adds on-hit damage at max stacks; it shreds nothing, and telling a K'Sante his armour is being invalidated pushes him off the build that wins this lane. (2) 'She can pull marks off your passive' — Irelia's Marks come from her own E and R; K'Sante's passive is unrelated. (3) 'Don't W into her W — she blocks the burst and you waste the unstoppable' is wrong twice over: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge rather than blocking, and Path Maker is damage reduction, not unstoppable. The interaction the page most needed and never stated: Bladesurge's cooldown REFRESHES on a Marked or dying target, which is the actual reason 'deny reset targets' is the win condition. Four chart rows contradicted the packet and the content prose; flipped as matched pairs. I did not assert the kit file's 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet — Riot's text says damaged, stunned and Marked, with no grounding.
